name: Pit Wall
description: Read-only panel: who is waiting on you, who is working, the state of every worktree and the PRs that need you. Each agent state has its own icon, and only what needs you moves.

cover.alt: Pit Wall next to its tagline: who is waiting on you, who is working, every worktree.

screenshots.alt: The Overview tab: counters, an org chart of projects with an icon per session state, and What to do now.
screenshots.caption: Every agent at a glance

screenshots.alt: The Sessions tab: sessions waiting on you with their last message, then sessions still working with their current tool.
screenshots.caption: What to do now

screenshots.alt: The Worktrees tab: worktrees grouped by project, each with its PR state, checks and agents waiting or working.
screenshots.caption: Every worktree, by project

screenshots.alt: The PRs tab: pull requests sorted by checks failing, checks running, ready for review and drafts, each with its checks and the agents in its worktree.
screenshots.caption: PRs that need you
